issues_detected.description: The dataset is clinical data from ICU, PICU and NICU admissions, yet no IRB or ethics board of record is documented. human_subject_research.source_caveats: 'The sources do not report an IRB approval number, an ethics review board of record, or any human subjects research determination for the dataset'. ethical_reviews describes the project's ethics pillar (focus groups, legal landscape analysis), which is programme activity rather than a review of this dataset.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record the IRB(s) of record and protocol/waiver identifiers covering retrospective extraction at the 14 contributing hospitals.

issues_detected.description: PICU and NICU admissions are explicitly in scope ('50,000 patient admissions from ICU, PICU, and NICU care'; subpopulations 'pediatric intensive care (PICU), and neonatal intensive care (NICU)') but at_risk_populations is absent and informed_consent is absent. direct_collection.is_direct: false implies a consent-waiver basis that is nowhere stated.

issues_detected.description: is_deidentified names tokenisation and 'approaches that limit re-identification' but no formal standard; the record says so: 'do not state a formal standard applied (such as HIPAA Safe Harbor or expert determination), nor a residual re-identification risk assessment'. participant_privacy.reidentification_risk restates intent ('specifically intended to limit re-identification') rather than a risk level. Imaging de-identification is reported as incomplete ('in process for a larger cohort').
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the de-identification standard per modality (OMOP tables, DICOM via CTP-deid, waveforms) and state a residual re-identification risk assessment.

issues_detected.description: confidentiality_level 'restricted' and every distribution format 'under controlled access', but no data license or DUA is named ('No license is stated for the dataset itself') and no HIPAA determination is recorded; the record correctly refuses to read a training-workshop mention of HIPAA as a compliance claim.
issues_detected.recommendation: Name the licensing agreement / DUA governing enclave access and record the HIPAA determination.

issues_detected.description: No DOI or RRID. id 'https://chorus4ai.org/#chorus-dataset' is a fragment minted on the project website; the record declares: 'The dataset identifier is minted as a fragment on the attested project website URL because no persistent dataset identifier is published.' issues_detected.recommendation: Mint a dataset DOI once a release is formalised and use it as id.

issues_detected.description: external_resources value 'www.bridge2ai.org/chorus' has no URL scheme; maintainers email 'cmccrary@mgh.havard.edu' carries an apparent domain typo which the record flags and does not correct ('this looks like a misspelling of "harvard", but no corrected address is given in the sources').

issues_detected.description: Released-size figures conflict across sources and are declared rather than reconciled: '50,000 patient admissions' (project_documentation) versus 'over 45K unique admissions' (cohort_2_webinar); '7,642 admissions with radiology data' versus '1000 images' measure different units. issues_detected.description: known_biases has one typed entry (selection_bias) with mitigation, but the caveat states 'do not report any measured bias analysis or demographic composition'; no fairness analysis or AIO mapping, and measurement bias across heterogeneous monitor vendors and sites is undocumented.

strengths: Substantive, sourced narrative: description (1,754 chars), five purposes, tasks and addressing_gaps are specific and consistent with the NIH award abstract.

Per-modality standards documented in conforms_to, conforms_to_standard and distribution_formats (OMOP CDM, OHNLP, DICOM, WFDB, EDF+/Persyst) with D4D schema conformance and a documented semantic-mapping process.

Collection and processing protocol is broad: typed acquisition methods, six mechanisms, collectors with roles, five raw sources with formats, and five preprocessing strategies naming their tools and repositories.

Rigorous epistemic hygiene: conflicting figures (50,000 vs 45K admissions), ambiguous units ('23 Tb'), an interleaved table, a contact-email typo and the '.edu' scoping are all declared rather than silently resolved.
Bias and limitations are typed (selection_bias; coverage, integration, representativeness and temporal limitations) with mitigations, and missing-data patterns are documented per modality.
weaknesses: No IRB/ethics board of record, no informed_consent or waiver basis, and no at_risk_populations entry despite PICU and NICU admissions being in scope.
No persistent identifier (DOI/RRID), no version, errata, publisher or named repository, so sustainability and versioning score poorly.
No named data license or DUA, no prohibited or discouraged uses, and no HIPAA or other regulatory determination.
No demographic characterisation of the 50,000 admissions, no inclusion/exclusion criteria, and no holdout-set size.
Tools are named without versions or per-repository URLs; no publication citations or recommended dataset citation; grant number carried only in prose.
recommendations: Add ethical_reviews and informed_consent entries with the IRB(s) of record and waiver determinations, plus at_risk_populations for children and neonates with the safeguards applied.
Mint a dataset DOI, record version and version_access, name the enclave/repository in publisher, and state a release schedule and preservation commitment in updates.

Name the licensing agreement or DUA in license_and_use_terms, add prohibited_uses/discouraged_uses, and record the HIPAA determination and de-identification standard per modality with a reidentification_risk assessment.
Add subpopulations for age group, sex and race/ethnicity with distributions, inclusion/exclusion criteria in sampling_strategies, and the holdout split size in splits.

Move the grant number into a structured Grant entity, give per-repository URLs and versions for OHNLP, DeGauss, CTP-deid and chorus_waveform, and add citation entries and related_datasets once available.
